Project Name: Predicting Loan Repayment delinquency for mobile micro finance services
Problem Identification: Predict customer loan eligibility using telecom recharge behavior, loan history, and usage over 30/90 days. Provide batch predictions and a real-time Flask API + web UI.
Data issues / EDA: Source: SQLite table Telecom_microservices_loan (~2M rows). Missing values; inconsistent date formats; class imbalance; numeric outliers. Current run uses 60k train + 20k eval; remaining rows treated as live.
ML Model: Primary: XGBoost in sklearn Pipeline (auto-fallback to RandomForest/SGD). Class imbalance via scale_pos_weight. Threshold tuned by policy: recall_at_fpr (≤10%) or F1.
Preprocess: Numeric coercion; median imputation; StandardScaler; OneHotEncoder for pcircle; msisdn dropped for modeling; leak-prone pdate removed; engineered features: payback_rate30/90, avg_loan_amt30/90, avg_rech_amt30/90, loan_to_recharge_ratio_30/90, repayment_ratio_30/90, recharge_growth, last_rech_dayofyear.
Results: Validation (recall@FPR≤10% policy): Accuracy 0.7176; Precision 0.9797; Recall 0.6914; F1 0.8106; ROC-AUC 0.9015; Threshold ≈ 0.7557; Eval N=20000; Pos rate≈87.45%. Artifacts: artifacts/loan_eligibility_model.joblib, artifacts/train_metadata.json, plots (ROC, CM, calibration). APIs: /api/predict, /api/predict-live, /api/metrics; UI pages: /, /metrics; risk bands + color coding.
Business Impact: Improves credit targeting and conversion, controls false positives with business-aligned threshold, provides transparent metrics/plots for governance; supports real-time scoring and batch inference.
